title: Now with Milly away such an idea for him to send the girl down there to learn to take photographs
html_source:
Milly Bloom is Leopold and Molly’s fifteen-year old daughter. She has been sent to Mulligar to study photography.

In Chapter 1, we learned that a friend of Buck Mulligan’s has met her and written a card about her.

Starting here, Milly becomes the main object of Molly’s thought for a few pages.
